method: Native filled SMT copper polygons versus circular via drill; mask-layer membership required; plated component/NPTH holes excluded.

policy.scope: Native SMT copper/through-via process screen; no CAD change or supplier approval.
policy.required_scope: Every native via whose drilled hole overlaps an exposed SMT copper land in the generated per-board VIA-IN-PAD.csv. Full-board via fill/cap is acceptable only after CAM confirms the exact via inventory.
do_not_substitute: Open via under an SMT land
policy.never_fill: Component PTH holes/slots, C301 lead holes, USB shell slots, mounting holes and NPTHs are not via-fill targets.
policy.small_land_review: Preserve original lands; obtain assembly approval for WLCSP round lands 0.22/0.23mm and the listed small rectangular lands. ENIG is mandatory; paste apertures, stencil thickness and solder voiding remain unqualified.
policy.coordinate_system: Unmirrored native PCB top-view millimeters. Positive Y follows KiCad board coordinates; Excellon export Y is negated. B.Cu rows must not be mirrored a second time.

boundaries: Native nominal geometry, not finished-hole tolerance or solder-process qualification.
Paste-layer membership is recorded; actual stencil apertures/area ratios/voiding are not certified.
No hits on Display does not waive its small-land or general assembly review.
